pages.expected_source: public discoverable package directory entries from canonical agent_packages projection, active run source from runtime_source_carriers, Home shortcut preferences, and readiness refs; selected project directory is session cwd and future domain workspace identity only
pages.machine_source: opl app state --profile fast --json#app_state.agent_packages.directory.entries + app_state.agent_packages.status_index + app_state.runtime_source_carriers.items[]

current_runtime_projection_boundary.canonical_projection: opl app state --profile fast --json#app_state.agent_packages.directory.entries + app_state.agent_packages.status_index + app_state.runtime_source_carriers.items[]
current_runtime_projection_boundary.display_metadata_policy: owner-projected display metadata only with package-id text fallback
current_runtime_projection_boundary.source_semantics_policy: directory entries own catalog membership, installed, activated, installability, coarse readiness, recommended_action_ref, and exact available_actions; status_index adds canonical package-id-keyed dependency_readiness, repair_action, activation_action, dependent_guard, capability_exposure, materialization, runtime-source, currentness, receipt, and status-read diagnostics but cannot override directory lifecycle, readiness, or exact actions; package_dependency_readiness remains lower-level diagnostic enrichment; runtime source carriers and modules may enrich source diagnostics only; the shell infers none of them
current_runtime_projection_boundary.diagnostic_enrichment_projection: opl app state --profile fast --json#app_state.agent_packages.status_index + app_state.runtime_source_carriers.items[] + app_state.modules.items[]
current_runtime_projection_boundary.normalization_policy: shell uses directory.entries as the only manageable collection, joins optional diagnostics by canonical package_id, and keeps directory lifecycle/readiness/actions authoritative on overlap
current_runtime_projection_boundary.canonical_directory_absent_policy: render loading, empty, last-good stale, or failed without synthesizing rows or actions from status_index, runtime_source_carriers, modules, Home shortcuts, or App metadata
current_runtime_projection_boundary.completion_boundary: canonical directory entries and their exact projected actions are required for manageable rows; status_index, runtime_source_carriers, modules, and Home shortcuts may enrich diagnostics only and never define collection membership, lifecycle, readiness, or actions

list_density_policy.content_block_policy: directory may include standard_agent, framework_capability_package, and workflow_profile package roles, but Skill, Plugin, workflow internals, connector, resource, and export catalogs remain on Capabilities or their owner pages
list_density_policy.first_screen_policy: default detail shows user-decision fields and owner-projected diagnostics only; private lifecycle storage and physical paths are not App inputs
list_density_policy.empty_field_policy: hide empty, unknown, unavailable, not_applicable, null, or unreported fields; never render 未报告 or Not reported as default user detail text
